rows.claim: With the four offsets, the agent can fill in the last value and re-run the validator in a few seconds.
rows.evidence: No tool output shows this. It is a forward-looking claim about speed. The validator did run instantly earlier, and the computation is simple (counts and sums were already computed), but no output demonstrates the fill-in and re-run with offsets.

rows.claim: Once offsets are added the mean will change by the readings-weighted average of the offsets.
rows.evidence: This follows from arithmetic. The calibrated mean equals the raw mean plus the sum of (count_s * offset_s)/N. The per-sensor counts shown in T0B5 (63, 62, 58, 57 of 240) and the raw mean in T0B7 (21.4266) are consistent with this. Nothing contradicts it.
